title: knautia arvensis var. sylvatica
intro: Knautia arvensis var. sylvatica, commonly known as the woodland or field scabious, is a plant species in the family Caprifoliaceae. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Knautia arvensis var. sylvatica include reducing inflammation, soothing skin irritations, and acting as an antiseptic.
